tested_mechanism: When an ambiguous target observation forces DEFER, expiration of old evidence must not itself authorize replay. A timeout may only expire the old observation and open a new evidence epoch; replay or skip requires a newly fresh, effect-identity-fenced observation in that epoch.

fixed_assumptions: Durable intent and deterministic effect identity are preserved
Initial target observation is ambiguous, so the predecessor rule returns DEFER
A newly fresh query, when decisive, truthfully distinguishes the same effect identity as applied versus fresh absent
Identity/generation mismatch is fenced to DEFER

result.timeout_without_new_evidence: FALSIFIED as a safe recurrence rule. In A1/C1 it converts unresolved epistemic uncertainty into a physical replay and duplicates an already-applied effect.
result.indefinite_defer: Safety-preserving but not a liveness mechanism; it cannot resolve hidden-absent cases without acquiring new evidence.
result.evidence_epoch_renewal: PASS for conditional safety plus conditional liveness in the exact tested scope: expiration only invalidates old evidence; newly fresh decisive same-identity evidence authorizes SKIP/RECOVER or one REPLAY, while uncertain or mismatched evidence remains DEFER.
result.liveness_limit: If a newly fresh decisive target observation cannot be obtained, evidence-epoch renewal preserves safety but cannot guarantee exactly-once progress.

mechanism_revision: Treat timeout/lease expiry as an evidence invalidation event, never as an action authorization event. Renewal advances an evidence epoch; semantic action remains gated by a fresh same-effect certificate in the new epoch.
neuroscience_transfer: In the role-local corollary-discharge analogy, decay of confidence in an old reafference comparison should trigger reacquisition of sensory evidence rather than invert the motor conclusion. The computational separation is prediction/evidence validity versus action polarity: an expired comparison becomes unknown, not opposite.
scope_guard: The positive claim is limited to the serialized single-writer symbolic cut with deterministic effect identity and truthful freshness/identity certificates. It does not prove liveness under permanently unavailable fresh observation, safety under a falsely certified stale query, concurrent-writer coordination, target corruption, nondeterministic effect ids, or distributed consensus.

mechanism_assessment.repository_transport_role: bounded role-local persistence/readback only; no hosted compute, runner, artifact service, cloud credit, external model, or repository API volume used as computation

mechanism_assessment.unresolved_child: Exactly-once liveness remains unresolved when Chat-native observable target state cannot provide a newly fresh decisive same-effect observation.
